# SDFM Group Limited

> SDFM Group is a company that helps businesses find where AI and automation will pay off, then builds the systems. It offers a free automation scoper, industry software and custom software builds.

## Services

- [Automation Scoper](https://sdfmgroup.com/ai-gap-check): a free, conversational assessment (about 10 minutes) that produces a gap report, a readiness score and the projected return of closing the gaps, with a PDF to keep.
- [Sample report](https://sdfmgroup.com/sample-report): a full example scoper report for an anonymised 28-person consultancy, with gaps, readiness scores and projected return.
- [Case examples](https://sdfmgroup.com/case-summaries): three illustrative before-and-after examples (a custom build, an industry system and a scoper-led project). Typical results, not specific clients.
- [Industry software](https://sdfmgroup.com/industry-solutions): end-to-end, ready-made systems for specific industries, so a business does not need to hire a developer. The first systems are coming soon.
- [Custom builds](https://sdfmgroup.com/custom-builds): custom software built around a business's own workflow, quoted per project after scoping, delivered in milestones, with training and support.

## Company

- [Book a call](https://sdfmgroup.com/book): book a free 30-minute call; visitors pick a time shown in their own time zone.
- [Contact](https://sdfmgroup.com/contact): WhatsApp, phone, email and an enquiry form.
- [Privacy policy](https://sdfmgroup.com/privacy-policy): how personal data is collected and used, under the GDPR, the CCPA and other applicable data protection laws.
